- `after` must be `None` or a string ID present in `records`; exclude the cursor record. Invalid cursors raise `ValueError`.
- `limit` must be an integer from 1–100; booleans are invalid.
- Return `{"items": page, "next_after": cursor}` in source order, preserving original values. Set `next_after` to the last item’s ID only when more records remain; otherwise `None`.
- Do not mutate `records`.
